stock.description: As an investment holding company, Super Strong Holdings Limited offers property development and building administration services within Hong Kong. The firm's operational scope includes a diverse range of activities, such as general and bespoke construction, demolition, site preparation, foundational works, electrical installations, and proprietary structural and finishing projects. The company was founded in 2015 and has its main office situated in Tokwawan, Hong Kong.
